selectionMetric: Equal-series/equal-horizon normalized 80% interval score on development 2/5-year folds. Lower is better.
limitations: Complete-record survivorship selection: closed, reclassified and incomplete institutions are excluded using full-window membership. Tests are retrospective, not real-time vintage experiments.
Tuition and housing panel membership differs. Housing is on-campus budget, not local rents. Source imputation flags are retained and counted, not silently treated as directly observed quotes.
School counts do not multiply independent economic periods. Public/private and residency series share institutions and macro history.
Final holdout is now consumed evidence; it must not be used for iterative tuning. No 18-year fold exists with 11 training levels in this panel.
P10–P90 coverage applies to comparable-school sector price indices; school-level coverage is separately reported. Neither establishes individual-family funding-probability calibration.
